instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check a member's chosen name for one shared space and answer their member row with it, for other members to read", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them); name (The name to show, 1 to 80 characters); records (The records the ask reads, as the caller read them from a store ({ id, type, value }): the space's record:space row, the member rows of the space (record:space-member), and, when a join row asks for access, the payment-event, record:commercial-offer, access-grant, access-effect-rule and effect-lifecycle rows.).

3. Read what comes back: Answers the person's own member row with the name set, at most 80 characters, under `keep` for the caller to store.
